create_vectorizer_count_tokens: create a CountVectorizer to tokenize text documents and build a document-term frequency matrix
create_vectorizer_hash_tokens: create a HashingVectorizer to hash text tokens into a fixed-size sparse feature matrix without building a vocabulary
create_vectorizer_tfidf_features: create a TfidfVectorizer to convert raw text documents into a TF-IDF weighted feature matrix
build_transformer_tfidf_normalize: build a TfidfTransformer to normalize a count matrix into TF-IDF weighted representations
test_vectorizer_strip_accents: test the strip_accents_ascii and strip_accents_unicode functions to remove accented characters from text strings
